title: Uncertainty over path of Cyclone Akvan; North A.P. and South Odisha put on alert now
description: According to an IMD bulletin issued at 8 p.m. on November 18, the landfall can be between Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh and Puri in Odisha on November 20 as a Severe Cyclonic Storm; experts say the system may weaken before landfall
